purpose.domain_detail: Patient inquiry subsystem for a healthcare application; retrieves patient demographic and insurance data from a DB2 PATIENT table by patient ID
purpose.summary: HCIPDB01 is a CICS online subprogram invoked by transaction HCAZ (option 2 - Inquire Patient). It receives a commarea containing a patient ID, queries the DB2 PATIENT table for demographic and insurance card details, and returns the results via the commarea with an appropriate return code.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with DB2 (SELECT with host variables, SQLCA, INCLUDE SQLCA)
EXEC SQL INCLUDE HCCMAREA in LINKAGE SECTION
EIB field references (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN)
COPY HCERRSWS and COPY HCERRSPD for error handling
Bug injection markers (%bug1, %bug2) suggesting training/demo use
USAGE IS POINTER for commarea address
